current.note: What www.emipws.org looks like today, built from EMIPws/emipws.github.io.

editorial.title: Editorial
editorial.note: Printed-report look: Source Serif and IBM Plex, a data-driven homepage with an animated scanpath figure, section rails on inner pages.

one-page.title: One page
one-page.note: Editorial look, but the whole site scrolls on one page: the menu jumps to each section, long texts are folded, and each workshop year keeps its own page.
